note: For each shot write need (what must literally be on screen for this sentence), 2-4 English queries (concrete first, then broader), kind (video|image), look (modern = today's colour HD footage, archive = old film and historical pictures, any), min (shortest side in px, optional) and avoid. Then: footage find <NN>.

shots.text: Have you ever wondered why some soils struggle to grow healthy plants, even when they receive enough water and fertilizer?
shots.need: dry cracked soil with wilting struggling crop

shots.text: One substance that can help improve soil conditions is humic acid.
shots.need: hands holding dark rich fertile soil

shots.text: Humic acid is an organic substance formed through the long-term decomposition of plant and animal materials in the soil.
shots.need: fallen leaves decomposing on forest floor, compost

shots.text: It plays an important role in improving soil structure, helping the soil retain moisture, and making certain nutrients more available to plants.
shots.need: water soaking into soil, crumbly moist soil

shots.text: It can also support root development and increase beneficial biological activity in the soil.
shots.need: plant roots and earthworms in soil

shots.text: Humic acid is commonly available in three forms: liquid, powder, and granules.
Each form has its own application method, so the right amount depends on the product concentration, plant type, and soil conditions.
shots.need: farmer applying fertilizer to field / sprayer

shots.text: But remember, humic acid is not a replacement for NPK fertilizers.
shots.need: NPK fertilizer granules spread on field

shots.text: It works alongside them to create better conditions for plant growth.
So, healthy plants start with healthy soil!
